fields.PRODUCT NAME: Traditional Brass Deepam / Samai Lamp Pair
fields.DESCRIPTION: Illuminate your home and pooja room with this Handcrafted Brass Samai Lamp, a symbol of divinity and prosperity. Crafted with precision, this tall lamp features a sturdy base, elegant stem, and a wide diya at the top, perfect for holding oil and wicks. Lighting this lamp is believed to bring positivity, wisdom, and blessings into the household.
